content.text: In regions where platforms like Stripe and PayPal are inaccessible, digital creators face barriers that stifle their ability to sell online. This guide outlines how to deploy a fully functional digital store on [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/cloudflare-r2-digital-product-storage-delivery-what-actually-10|cloudflare]] Pages using Stack 02 from COREMERCH, ensuring automatic [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/crypto-payment-gateways-digital-products-explained-digital-creators-6|COREMERCH guide to crypto]] [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-get-payment-gateways-cameroon-digital-products-live|How to]] processing and complete data ownership. You will learn to circumvent traditional payment gateways and embrace a robust, sovereign infrastructure that empowers your online business.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The infrastructure created through Stack 02 leverages Cloudflare's robust services, enabling creators to host their digital products securely and efficiently. Unlike conventional platforms, this stack is built on a foundation of sovereignty, ensuring that you own your data and don't rely on external services that can limit your access or impose fees. By implementing NOWPayments for crypto transactions, you bypass the limitations of traditional payment processors, effectively solving the issue of payment rejection and currency instability.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before launching your digital store, gather the necessary components: access to Cloudflare Pages for hosting, setup of Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, and integration with Supabase for order management. Additionally, establish your NOWPayments account to facilitate automatic payment processing with over 300 cryptocurrencies. Ensure you have at least five digital products ready for upload, along with all materials needed for configuration and testing. This preparation is essential for a smooth deployment process.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Begin by deploying your digital store on Cloudflare Pages, which offers a reliable hosting solution. Next, configure Cloudflare Workers to handle backend processes, including order validation and data management. Integrate Supabase to store order information and manage customer data efficiently. Finally, connect your NOWPayments account to automate payment processing, ensuring that all transactions occur seamlessly on-chain. This setup guarantees that your customers receive immediate access to products upon payment confirmation.
Take control of your digital sales without relying on traditional payment platforms.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

With your infrastructure in place, it’s time to go live. Test your payment processing by making a small transaction to verify that everything works as expected. Ensure that your product delivery pipeline is functioning correctly by confirming that customers receive their products instantly upon successful payment. Use the testing features provided by NOWPayments to simulate various transaction scenarios. Once you have confirmed that all systems are operational, promote your digital store to your target audience.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After your digital store is live, focus on scaling your operations. Monitor the performance of your store and utilize analytics from Supabase to understand customer behavior. Consider expanding your product line beyond the initial five offerings to capture a broader audience. You can also integrate additional tools or features to enhance customer experience, such as marketing automation or customer feedback systems. The Complete Builder Kit from COREMERCH is an excellent resource for additional blueprints and templates to support your scaling efforts.

The difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 is not which one works — both work — it is which one fits your situation. Stack 01 is the right choice if you want to deploy yourself, you are comfortable with Google Workspace tools, and your initial volume is under 100 orders per day. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the complete Stack 01 build with full source code and step-by-step configuration. Stack 02 is the right choice if you want the deployment done for you, you need higher volume capacity, or you want email deliverability infrastructure configured from day one. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH deploy Stack 02 under your accounts in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Leverage Cloudflare's infrastructure for fast and secure hosting solutions.

The setup decision comes down to time versus depth. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you everything to build Stack 01 yourself in an afternoon or Stack 02 over a weekend — full source code, step-by-step configuration, and the NOWPayments integration guide. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH build Stack 02 for you in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff, with SPF, DKIM, and DMARC configured for email deliverability. Both paths lead to a store you own completely. Both are at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Read the Sovereign Blueprint before you start configuring anything — understanding the complete architecture before touching any settings prevents the most common configuration mistakes. Create all required accounts first: NOWPayments, Cloudflare or GitHub, Supabase or Google account, Resend or Gmail. Then configure the backend with all credentials before deploying it. Then deploy the backend and confirm the endpoint is live. Then configure NOWPayments with the endpoint URL. Then build and deploy the storefront. Then configure your custom domain if using one. Then run the mainnet test. Then check the order database. Then — and only then — share the URL. The sequence is not arbitrary. Each step depends on the previous one.

To build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free, utilize Cloudflare Pages for hosting and integrate NOWPayments for handling transactions. This allows you to bypass traditional payment limitations and maintain complete control over your sales.

Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages and Apps Script, while Stack 02 is built on Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and Supabase. Stack 02 offers enhanced scalability and features, ensuring a more robust infrastructure for your digital store.

Yes, you can host a digital product store on either GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. However, Cloudflare Pages combined with the right backend tools provides a more scalable solution with better performance.
How long does it take to deploy Stack 02?
Stack 02 is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours, ensuring that your digital store is ready for operation without unnecessary delays, fully tested and configured before handoff.
What payment methods can I use with NOWPayments?
NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, allowing you to accept a diverse range of digital assets as payment for your products. This flexibility is critical for reaching a wider audience.
